m_q_norank.why: quicksearch sorts by date again but still binds the rank: the binds are unused = ORA-01036 (the trap of an ORDER BY dropped without its binds)

m_s_norank.why: MODE search sorts by date alone again (rank and its binds both gone): the repository's 50 = the newest 50

m_countbind.why: the rank binds also go on the search COUNT, which reuses the WHERE: ORA-01036 on every repository search (the brief's named trap)

m_noescape.why: the term goes into the word-start regex unescaped: a.b matches AXB, an open paren is ORA-12725

m_noword.why: no word-start tier: a word hit (fi-epa, Annual Budget Review) ranks with a mid-word one (DEPARTMENT, Overbudget)

m_tierswap.why: a tag / owner / access-list hit ranks as tier 1, above the word and contains tiers

m_gate.why: under the discovery gate a non-admin's rank reaches the owner and the access list again

m_tagrank.why: tag:NAME (exact) gets ranked against its own text instead of newest first

m_long.why: no length guard: a long term's regex passes Oracle's 512-byte pattern limit (ORA-12733)

m_phpfold.why: the term is folded in PHP (strtoupper is byte-wise: cafe-accent never matches) instead of by Oracle

m_ownername.why: quicksearch's rank forgets the owner-by-name ids: a report found by its owner's name sorts with the SQL hits

m_notags.why: a tag hit is not tier 4: it sorts with the SQL hits
